contact.basis: Fixed open front approach within the photograph-estimated former forecourt, chosen before terrain acquisition. Modern source relief is context only, not a1923grade survey or hotel foundation.

verticalDatum: Terrarium source mean-sea-level composite; host-relative visualization, not a surveyed datum
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Unmodified Terrarium pixels bilinearly sampled at pixel centers in the signed local model frame. Heights are not flattened or fitted to the building.
limitations: Pixel spacing is not native DEM resolution or vertical accuracy. Building/vegetation returns and urban interpolation may be present.
Terrain-contact runtime placement samples the host at the declared reference point. Compatibility with other terrain datasets remains host-dependent.
